summary: Server one-frame request to create a spell zone (cone/line area of a spell; seen alive when a Mud Mephit cast a spell, born together with esv::zone::SpellComponent and FinishedEventOneFrameComponent). It is one esv::zone::CreationParams (0x188 bytes): esv::zone::CreationSystem::ProcessCreateRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x114C5E0) walks CreationParams with stride 0x188, creates the zone entity, fills esv::zone::SpellComponent from it and copies the whole CreationParams with the assignment FUN_18114c290 (EoCServer.dll+0x114C290), which gives every member's offset and width. The builder FUN_18164dc50 (EoCServer.dll+0x164DC50) names the member types (SpellId, InitialTarget, eoc::SpellZoneInfo, optional arrays of AiTilePos / EntityHandle / HitDesc). Game defaults from creator bg3.exe+0x3377AF0.
